profile.supported: Named fields with ordinal lookup, escaped braces, valid Unicode text/codepoint fill-width-precision and !s. None/bool/Int64 empty spec; explicit !s before supported text spec. No positional arguments.
profile.unsupported: repr/ascii, item/attribute lookup, nested spec, float/container/native values actually formatted, integer numeric specs, unqualified leading-zero widths. No reflection, implicit JSON serialization or fallback interpreter.
profile.diagnostics: Source error types/messages are recorded, not required to equal C# Diagnostic.Code/text. A valid Python form outside the profile remains an unsupported feature/value, not a Python syntax error.
profile.productBudgets: Future product-only limits: format64Ki code points, width/precision1Mi, output1Mi code points plus checked UTF16; no source stress-allocation case.

limitations: True source StringFormat and builtin str.format only, no fixture body. Actual Schema/TemplateNames/acquisition/mapper/binder/NodeOutput. No general HTTP validation, no .NET execution, no renderer/formatter parity beyond the declared partition.

Exact strings, typed input/cache data and explicit order lists; source errors compare phase/category, not message text. Unsupported-profile source results are observations, never successful C# expectations.

Only a sole $blocker in cached fixture data decodes to the actual source ExecutionBlocker. Prompt dictionaries remain ordinary data. Return encoding preserves scalars/containers and explicitly records dictionary order.
No C# execution/expected output, HTTP validation or native model operation.
Unsupported-profile source outputs are not successful port expectations.
